_: ONE table, read by both readers of a card's **Agent:** footer line (consts.json stamps.agent; docs/hub/cards.md, "The footer"): Scripts/Get-PromptFileStatus.ps1 Get-P20CardAgent (tkTestToolkit -Triage) and agent/core/parsers.py card_agent() (Tests/test_parsers.py). Each row's lines are joined with LF, or CRLF when crlf is true, into a card's text, and both readers are asked who did the work. expected is the value of the FIRST line that starts with the stamp, trimmed -- a model id, as written, never parsed -- and '' when no line starts with it (a person worked the card alone). assigned is what the **Assigned:** reader says of the same text, so a row proves the two lines are read apart. If the two halves ever disagree about a row, one of them is wrong.

rows.name: no line: a person worked it alone
an Assigned line only: an owner, no agent
Assigned and Agent together: the person owns it, the agent worked it
the same lines in a CRLF card
spaces around the value are not part of it
an id the map does not know reads as written
an empty line names no agent
the stamp inside a sentence is not the line
lines: Nobody wrote **Agent:** grok-4 here at the start of a line.
